question: Among users who have never cast a downvote (DownVotes = 0), find the percentage of those with the lowest reputation who have posted comments scoring below 10.

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c."XCL_007" < 10 THEN u."XCL_052" END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT u."XCL_052")
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN comments c ON c."XCL_010" = u."XCL_052"
WHERE u."XCL_062" = 0
  AND u."XCL_053" = (SELECT MIN("XCL_053") FROM users WHERE "XCL_062" = 0)
